classification.difficultyReason: Count incident edges at each vertex and identify the vertices whose degrees are even.

content.prompt: In the network shown, the number of vertices of even degree is

spec.description: Seven unlabelled vertices with ten undirected edges. The central vertex lies on the horizontal and vertical lines. Every vertex has a prominent black marker.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left, middle-left and lower-left vertices each have degree 3; upper-middle and lower-middle each have degree 2; centre has degree 6; right endpoint has degree 1.
spec.answerVisibility: The student figure contains no degree labels or answer annotations.

answer.worked: The upper-middle and lower-middle vertices each have degree 2. The centre vertex has degree 6. The other vertices have degrees 3, 3, 3 and 1, which are odd. Therefore, 3 vertices have even degree.
